correctness.rationale: For every real 2-by-2 SPD A with lambda_min(A)>= (1+sqrt(2))/2, the explicit polarity numerators det(A)-z_2(a+c) and det(A)-z_1(d+c) are positive by a PSD decomposition and AM--GM: 4L(L-1)>=1. The exact resolvent flip identity shows all sign-consistent states maximize F and all mismatches improve under their flips. For every 1<L<the boundary, a rank-one positive-semidefinite perturbation of LI gives prescribed least eigenvalue and negative polarity at a sign state; a small explicit right-hand-side perturbation creates a unique inconsistent global maximizer. Both directions and equality endpoints are analytic. Exact-rational code separately checks the finite witness and representative matrices, not the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: A source-defined potential-based sign algorithm has an exact sharp robust frontier on the smallest coupled symmetric-positive-definite class. The nontrivial interval 1/2<rho(|A^{-1}|)<=2(sqrt2-1) enjoys a uniform global-maximizer guarantee even though it is outside the existing general theorem; the explicit rank-one SPD counterexample establishes the exact boundary without loss of AVE uniqueness. It motivates spectral-aware safe sign-potential analysis for structured inverse problems.
